{{Top|leg}}
The '''''nor'cabur''''', or backplate, was a piece of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that protected the wearer's back. The ''nor'cabur'' connected to the ''[[Ghet'bur|ghet'bur]]'', or gorget, and was reinforced to help bear the weight of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior's [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]].<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
